name: Monster colors: Splashell and Gustling
notes: Shared colors of Splashell and Gustling's sprites and portraits: 1 = dark outline, 2 = white, 3-8 = Splashell's light / mid / dark body colors and 3 accent colors, 9-14 = Gustling's, 15 = pink blush. Light comes from the top-left: light on the upper-left, dark low on the right.
